note: Only terms a beginner actually needs for this specific lesson that were not already introduced in Lesson 1. 'Sahabi/Companion' and 'kunyah' are assumed from Lesson 1 and not repeated here.

terms.definition_ar: الدعوةُ إلى الإسلام، أي تعريف الناس بالإيمان بالله ورسوله ودعوتهم إليه. أبو بكر هو أول من قام بهذا بعد إيمانه هو نفسه.
terms.definition_en: The call or invitation to Islam -- introducing people to belief in Allah and His Messenger and inviting them to it. Abu Bakr began doing this himself immediately after his own acceptance of Islam.
